parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Name of the Request-URI parameter. If {{param}} is {{empty}}, the name of the Request-URI parameter is the value of {{param|Reference}}.

parameters.name: Reference
parameters.description: The value MUST be the path name of a parameter to be used as the Request-URI parameter. If the value of this parameter is empty, then this object is not encoded in the report header.

object.description: This object represents an instance of a parameter to be used in the report header used as part of the HTTP Request-URI transmitted by the CPE to the collection server using the Request-URI in addition to the parameters required by {{template|BULK-DATA-HTTP-QUERY-REF}}.
